name: ESO 294-010 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 294-010, a transition-type dwarf galaxy in the Sculptor Group, seen by Hubble.
label: eso294010-hubble
story: ESO 294-010 is a small transition-type dwarf galaxy in the Sculptor Group, one of the closest groups of galaxies to our Local Group. Among its stars are RR Lyrae variables and horizontal branch stars, an ancient population comparable in age to the globular clusters of the Galactic halo.
